Therefore, the artifact score should reflect the technical quality of the image (which is decent) rather than penalizing the species mismatch again.

The fine_grained_classifier failed to catch this semantic error, ranking 'green mamba' #1, likely due to the dominant green color and arboreal context overriding specific morphological features.
